rv.q: The inventive physical acting of all five is breathtaking.

Fly, You Fools! is bringing non-stop laughter to Southwark Playhouse Borough with this hour-long parody of The Fellowship of the Ring. Recent Cutbacks presents Fly, You Fools! at Southwark Playhouse following two successful runs at the Edinburgh Fringe.
One does not simply sit and watch Fly, You Fools; instead, it is impossible not to be swept up within the chaos, comedy, and craft of this impressively charming piece of theatre.
‘Fly, You Fools!’ is a clever, entertaining and brilliantly orchestrated shoestring parody that could be even stronger with a little more chaos.

cn.t: Critics agree Fly You Fools is a brilliantly inventive Lord of the Rings parody. Four performers deliver big laughs through shadow puppetry and physical comedy in this clever, shoestring production.
